V1_BASE_CONTINUITY.purpose: Exercise the intended multi-turn journey in order.

V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK.purpose: Seed trusted context before the journey and prove known fields are not unnecessarily re-asked.

V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY.purpose: Inject the journey-specific correction, interruption, or action-boundary risk.

V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT.purpose: Exercise language continuity, stale-context resistance, or the highest-risk edge for that journey.

variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: seed Grade 8 Math; ask price then package difference without re-asking grade/subject
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: after package comparison user asks to register; registration must start intake without claiming completion
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: after pricing/package context switch clearly to Physics; current subject inquiry overrides package context

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: subject inquiry -> pricing -> price objection -> explicit free trial request
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: seed Grade 8 Math and quoted packages; objection must not restart discovery
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: price objection followed by trial request must not invent discount or claim trial booked
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: after objection user asks unrelated teacher-quality question; current question wins without losing compatible student context

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: trial details -> explicit start trial -> registration intake
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: seed grade/subject before trial details; explicit start reuses both
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: information-only trial question must not collect parent data until explicit start request
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: explicit start trial after long informational exchange still enters free-trial intake, not stale trial-details mode

variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: seed Grade 8 Math and parent intake fields; scheduling cannot restart registration fields
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: availability question must not become booking; later schedule request remains unconfirmed until action success
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: schedule request after registration interruption must preserve compatible student data and current requested day/time

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: ask availability -> request specific slot -> receive/consider safe alternative
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: seed subject/grade/timezone/day/time; live-check response cannot re-ask all known fields
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: no live result means LIVE_CHECK_REQUIRED; alternative cannot be presented as booked
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: customer changes requested time; new time replaces stale requested time without altering subject/grade

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: known Grade 8 Math -> explicit correction to Grade 9
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: correction updates grade while preserving Math and does not ask grade again
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: correction during scheduling must not imply schedule/booking success
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: correct subject after earlier grade correction; latest explicit field values win independently

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: son Grade 8 Math -> explicit switch to daughter Grade 10 Physics
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: safe parent-shared location/language may carry; old child grade/subject may not
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: student switch during registration must not submit or merge two child records silently
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: switch child and language in same/current adjacent turn; new child context and current language both win

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: active sales discussion -> explicit human handoff request
variants.V2_KNOWN_CONTEXT_NO_REASK: known contact/handoff context is reused only if collection is authorized
variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: human request suspends sales and cannot claim handoff success without runtime success
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: after handoff request, a stale sales objective must not continue unless customer explicitly returns to it

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: pricing/sales -> technical support or complaint interruption

variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: support/complaint priority stops conversion pressure and action assumptions
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: customer later explicitly returns to pricing; resume only on that new signal and with compatible context

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: active pricing/trial journey -> general refund policy -> customer returns to pricing

variants.V3_OVERRIDE_OR_ACTION_SAFETY: general refund policy inquiry must never become refund execution or guaranteed eligibility
variants.V4_EDGE_LANGUAGE_OR_STALE_CONTEXT: if customer asks a new unrelated subject after policy answer, new subject wins rather than auto-resuming pricing

variants.V1_BASE_CONTINUITY: long subject -> pricing -> objection -> trial-details chain -> new clear subject inquiry
